entities.name: TsaD tRNA transferase
observations: 325 aa; predicted molecular weight 34.56 kDa and pI 6.26.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Trichodesmium erythraeum TsaD Q115B3; identity and coverage 100%.
Contains TsaD Pfam domain PF00814.32 at residues 23–318.
Likely binds one Fe2+ ion per subunit based on reviewed homolog annotation.

entities.name: t6A37 tRNA modification
observations: Transfers the threonylcarbamoyl group from threonylcarbamoyl-AMP to N6 of adenosine 37 in tRNA, producing t6A37 and AMP.
Annotated EC 2.3.1.234; Rhea references RHEA:37059, RHEA:10162, and RHEA:10163.

entities.name: tRNA threonylcarbamoyladenosine modification
observations: The protein participates in formation of t6A37 on tRNAs decoding codons beginning with adenine.
The reaction functions together with TsaE and TsaB in the bacterial t6A biosynthesis system.

entities.name: TsaD iron binding
observations: Reviewed homolog annotation states one Fe2+ ion is bound per protein subunit; this supports an iron-dependent catalytic or structural role.

entities.name: Bacterial cytoplasm
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated to the cytoplasm; no signal peptide or transmembrane segment is apparent from the provided sequence.
